profile.title: Data and Business Analyst
profile.bio: Data and Business Analyst with 3+ years of experience across operations, marketing, finance, and revenue reporting, building the data infrastructure businesses rely on and turning data into decisions. Designed Snowflake data solutions, SQL/Python ETL workflows, and Power BI/Tableau dashboards that reduced manual reporting effort by 40% and improved data quality by 35%, while delivering $20K+ in cost savings and revenue growth through analytics initiatives.
